failure_patterns.pattern: parameter_binding_and_canonicalization: Calls misbound fields or values, misplaced parameters, or omitted requested optional constraints and selectors.

rejected_edits.content: - Do not guess opaque lookup identifiers (such as numeric country or catalog IDs) from a name. Use a documented lookup or an explicitly supplied or canonical value; if no mapping is available, leave an optional ID filter unset and use any supported textual filter instead.
rejected_edits.target: - When a schema splits one supplied identifier across component fields, parse it according to those field definitions and pass each component only to its corresponding field (for example, a username/local part and a domain). Do not repeat the entire compound identifier in each component field.

rejected_edits.content: - Each entry in either parameter array must be a complete object with `name` and `value` keys; do not flatten parameter fields across array entries. Check balanced braces and brackets and verify the JSON is parseable before sending.
